Mia Chen: heads up — support ticket from Aurora regarding March invoice: reserved capacity line missing, and they got a second invoice later with 0 lines but a charge id. cc @Raj :eyes:
Raj Patel: sending over the ticket and raw invoice IDs now. ticket# 78823. looks like generator retried at 23:00 UTC and produced invoice  inv_20260315_01 then a retry inv_20260315_02
Mia Chen: exact customer timezone is Asia/Tokyo — they say cutoff is midnight JST.
Raj Patel: digging into the run logs. our invoice-window uses server UTC cutoff; pruning step converts local usage to UTC incorrectly for accounts with reserved commitments.
Gil Rodriguez: do you have the log snippet? can we repro locally against their account?
Raj Patel: paste from the billing-run log: ```INFO 2026-03-15T14:59:59Z billing: starting proration for acct=aurora id=acct_443
INFO 2026-03-15T15:00:00Z billing: computed window end=2026-03-14T23:59:59+09:00 but conversion yielded 2026-03-14T14:59:59Z -> excluded commitment lines
ERROR 2026-03-15T15:00:05Z billing: invoice-empty after proration, raising RetryableInvoiceError```
Emma Liu: so commitments exist in the DB but were filtered out by the conversion bug? we need a manual correction asap. customer is on reserved plan.
Raj Patel: yep. the retry path created a second invoice with no line items and a charge placeholder while the first invoice was left marked "processing" and then voided. that charge id shouldn't have been exposed.
InvoiceBot: automated alert: invoice-generator v2.4 fell back to retry mode for acct_443 at 2026-03-15T15:00:06Z (retry_count=1)
Mia Chen: suggested immediate steps?
Gil Rodriguez: manual fix plan: 1) regenerate invoice using the fix branch that uses canonical account tz (branch: fix/billing-tz-proration), 2) credit the phantom charge, 3) mark the voided invoice as replaced. I can run step 1 with a dry-run.
Emma Liu: finance approves credit for phantom charge and replacement invoice, but we need an audit entry for the change and a customer note. please include the proration detail and delta.
Raj Patel: I'll open a PR with the repro test and deploy hotfix to the billing-runner. also adding an integration test that simulates non-UTC account cutoff.
Mia Chen: Gil, go ahead with dry-run and paste the regenerated invoice preview. include tokenized IDs only (no full chargeids).
Gil Rodriguez: dry-run result: ```invoice_preview: {account: acct_443, period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-15, lines: [reserved-gpu: $1200.00, usage-overage: $32.40], total: $1232.40}``` looks correct.
Emma Liu: thanks. afterwards we'll issue credit note for inv_20260315_02 and email Aurora with replacement invoice and explanation.
Mia Chen: tracked in ticket# 78823 and billing-ops runbook. add postmortem item: ensure retry path doesn't surface phantom chargeids.
Raj Patel: created PR #842 and test added. will monitor next nightly run.
Mia Chen: great. tagging @InvoiceBot to monitor for any further zero-line invoices for acct_443 in next 48h :thumbsup:
InvoiceBot: monitoring enabled for acct_443 for 48h. will send alerts to #finance and #eng-billing.
